# Erdős #461: for each t, residues r_p (one per prime p < t) of an n with f(n,t) = min_n f(n,t).
# Convention: n = -r_p mod p^{e_p}, where e_p is least with p^{e_p} >= t; so p^a | n+j iff j = r_p mod p^a (a <= e_p).
# Format: t  f  p:r_p ...   (t = 2 has no primes; f(n,2) = 1 for every n)
